products.name: Continental Crown Championship Belt
products.shortDescription: A deep-etched CNC championship belt built around a crowned oval centre plate, finished in 24k gold plating over polished silver and mounted on a sealed-edge cowhide strap.
products.description: Our Continental Crown is a six-millimetre CNC-machined championship belt. The centre plate carries a raised crown above a mirror-polished oval, framed by scrollwork banners and deep-etched pillars. Four matching side plates carry globe and grappler motifs. Every plate is 24k gold plated over a polished silver base, and the strap is a full-grain cowhide with a sealed, painted edge and tooled border.

products.name: Stacked Gold Heavyweight Championship Belt
products.shortDescription: A stacked, multi-layer CNC heavyweight belt in 24k gold with cubic zirconia stone settings, silver globe inlays and a sealed-edge cowhide strap.
products.description: The Stacked Gold Heavyweight is built from layered 4mm CNC plates, giving the centrepiece genuine depth rather than a single flat casting. The face is 24k gold plated with contrasting silver lettering, set with cubic zirconia stones around the border. Six side plates — four globe medallions and two slim accent ovals — run down a sealed-edge cowhide strap with a tooled scalloped border.

products.name: Stone-Set World Championship Belt
products.shortDescription: Our most heavily stone-set build: a 6mm CNC world title with fully jewelled borders, extra side plates and a sealed-edge cowhide strap.
products.description: The Stone-Set World is the most ornate belt in the range. Every plate edge is lined with cubic zirconia, and the centre plate layers a diamond-cut field behind raised lettering with an engravable nameplate at the base. Four extra side plates — two carrying roundel medallions, two carrying rosette scrollwork — extend the jewelled run further down the strap than a standard build. Plates are 24k gold plated with silver inlay, on sealed-edge cowhide.
